FAQ

Common questions

Which pairs does NAVI v3 trade?
NAVI v3 supports all major forex pairs including XAUUSD (Gold), EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, NAS100 and more. The AI scanner works across all timeframes.
Does it work on MetaTrader?
Yes. NAVI v3 is fully compatible with both MetaTrader 4 (MT4) and MetaTrader 5 (MT5) on Android, iOS and PC.
How do I buy and get access?
Choose your version above, pay via Capitec, then send your proof of payment to our WhatsApp. Our team will install and activate your license within hours.
What happens right after I pay?
Send your proof of payment to our WhatsApp support. Our team will verify and contact you to begin installation and setup immediately.
Do you offer refunds?
Due to the digital nature of the product, we do not offer refunds once the license has been activated. Please reach out before purchasing if you have any questions.
Is the AI scanner just random signals?
No. The scanner uses AI-powered chart analysis to detect trading opportunities by reading market structure, momentum and price action in real time — not random signals.
Which broker should I use?
We recommend JustMarkets for optimal performance with NAVI v3. You can open an account using our affiliate link in the Links section below.
Are profits guaranteed?
No. Trading involves risk and profits are never guaranteed. NAVI v3 is a tool to assist — proper risk management remains your responsibility.
How do I contact support before or after buying?
You can reach us on WhatsApp at any time. Chat with us →
